"Build a playable 3D survival game called STONE WORLD: REBIRTH.

Platform: Mobile and Web browser. Make it responsive for Android phones, tablets and desktop PCs.

GAMEPLAY:
The player wakes up 3,700 years after humanity mysteriously turned into stone. Nature has taken over the world. The player must survive and rebuild civilization using science.

FEATURES:

1. Third-person 3D character with smooth movement.
2. Mobile joystick and touch camera controls.
3. PC keyboard and mouse controls.
4. Open-world forest with rivers, mountains, trees and rocks.
5. Collect wood, stone, berries and plants.
6. Inventory and resource management.
7. Hunger, thirst and health systems.
8. Craft stone tools, weapons and campfires.
9. Build houses and laboratories.
10. Day and night cycle.
11. Wildlife and survival challenges.
12. Science research and technology progression.
13. Save and load game progress.
14. Beautiful survival game graphics and animations.

PROGRESSION:
Stone Age → Bronze Age → Iron Age → Industrial Age → Modern Civilization.

DESIGN:
Create a beautiful 3D anime-inspired survival environment with original characters and original artwork. Include a main menu, playable world, inventory, crafting menu and survival HUD.

IMPORTANT:
Generate a working playable game, not just a static design. Prioritize character movement, resource collection, inventory and crafting in the first version. Make everything touch-friendly on mobile and playable with keyboard and mouse on desktop.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser survival game called STONE WORLD: REBIRTH, responsive for mobile and desktop, prioritizing movement, resource collection, inventory, and crafting.

## Requirements
- Third-person 3D exploration, mobile joystick/touch look, PC keyboard/mouse.
- Forest world with rivers, mountains, trees, rocks; gatherable resources; survival HUD; crafting/building; day/night; wildlife; research progression; save/load.
- Anime-inspired original presentation, main menu, inventory, crafting menu, survival HUD.
- Progression: Stone Age → Bronze Age → Iron Age → Industrial Age → Modern Civilization.
- Do not ask questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained Three.js world using original procedural geometry and UI rather than external art assets.
- Core first-version loop centers on movement, gathering, inventory, crafting/building, survival meters, and localStorage saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created game interface and responsive styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Built a procedural Three.js forest scene, original character, movement, gathering, inventory/crafting/building/research UI, survival systems, day/night, and save/load in `game.js`.
- `node --input-type=module --check < game.js` passed.
- Started local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser successfully loaded page and game.
